reviews.title: Moon
reviews.text: I asked you where to look for the moon now. You don’t answer.

reviews.title: A problem
reviews.text: In Extended Solar Systems can not update or install? There is an issue

reviews.title: What an incredible waste
reviews.text: This used to be a good app. But they’ve put everything including the kitchen sink into it and now have made it impossible to do the basic. If I am looking at the night sky, what am I looking at. It used to be good at telling you. But now all I get are static images, like it has no idea where I’m looking. Among its hundreds of choices, none seem to do that. Don’t waste your money.

reviews.title: Constellation search bar size
reviews.text: I would think there is away to search constellations by their size and not just alphabetical order.  Once this adjustment is made I will give it the 5 stars.  This is a client that also purchased the book.

reviews.title: It was good years ago
reviews.text: Trash. TRASH. TRASH. Do better, please.

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.text:
Why have you messed about with Sky Live?
Please reinstate the previous version without delay.

reviews.title: Used to use it all the time, it’s not accurate anymore.
reviews.text: This was a very useful app in finding out what a given star planet was. But lately it’s been way off. It can’t even find the moon.

reviews.title: Cannot Set Time. Waste of Money
reviews.text:
I already paid for Star Walk 2, and now I ended up paying again for Star Walk 2 Pro. There is no noticeable difference between the two versions, and the same bugs are still there. This feels like a complete waste of money.

I would like a refund.

reviews.title: Your “update” destroyed my workflow
reviews.text: I used your app to compare the sun and moon risings and settings.  It enabled me to plan my photography times.  It was easy to coordinate because the info was available on a single page.  After you “improved” update, I must now bounce back and forth between various pages to get the info I need.  Bring back the old format, please.

reviews.title: Don’t nag me to review your app
reviews.text: I’ve used it for 30secs and the app nags me for a review.

reviews.title: Best APP EVER
reviews.text: This app sucks now they changed sky live, which I used to use all the time and now it just doesn’t make any sense. I hate this app now.

reviews.title: Horribly inaccurate
reviews.text: I've used this app for years and now it's completely inaccurate. I've double checked that my location and date are correct. It's saying the moon rises at 7am in NYC today, while SkySafari and Stellarium both correctly show that it rises at 10:42pm. If I hadn't double checked the other apps, I would have planned a moonless viewing night with friends and had it ruined by the moon

reviews.title: Bloody Academics
reviews.text: This is now so complicated you cannot simply identify a celestial object, or, more importantly, ask where one you want to identify is. The app has lost its way. It used to be so simple. I have no idea who has possessed it but they need to get a reality pill.

reviews.title: The Sky Live page ruined in 1/2026 update
reviews.text: The Sky Live page went from integrated to atomized. Aesthetics ruined. Bye.

reviews.title: What happened?
reviews.text:
Did private equity take over or something? This is exactly the same as the original Starwalk, with everything stripped away as dlc and seemingly abandoned in terms of serious development. 

This once felt designed to be a scientific tool, now it’s just desperately monetized at any cost.
